value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#16
value.text: Morrie Bench is Mary Jane's ex-boyfriend, and as Hydro-Man he stalks her and kidnaps her to win her back. She lures him away from water, and he evaporates.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#60
split.text: Hydro-Man returns and kidnaps Mary Jane on her honeymoon, and he turns out to be a clone made by Miles Warren.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Her ex-boyfriend, whose clone kidnaps her on her honeymoon.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Morrie's ex-girlfriend, whom his clone kidnaps.

verdicts.why: The stalking, kidnapping and evaporation are all in Hydro-Man (#16). The honeymoon kidnapping (#59) and the clone reveal (#60) are kept as a split stage at #60 instead of being dropped.
Aunt May sets Peter up on a blind date with her friend Anna's niece, and Peter meets Mary Jane at the end of Return of the Spider Slayers (#3).
In Amazing Fantasy (#1) Lonnie asks to partner with Peter in science class on Pearl's recommendation, and Peter gets to know and like him.
Lonnie asks Pearl to be his girlfriend and she says yes in episode 1, so they are a couple from #1 until the breakup in #8.
In The Unicorn Unleashed! (#5) Gargan pulls a karambit on Big Donovan, and Lonnie tackles him and takes the blade in his arm.
The Scorpions and the 110th Street Gang face off in #5, and Gargan sneaks up to stab Big Donovan until Lonnie stops him.
In Scorpion Rising (#7) Gargan, in Octavius's armor, severely injures Spider-Man until Norman sends a glider to rescue him.
In Hitting the Big Time (#4) Spider-Man chases the Russian crew, Mila escapes, and Mikhail, Dmitri and Roxanna are arrested. The breakout is #5 and is carried by stage 1's new text.
At the end of #5 Mikhail warns Spider-Man he will not get away so easily next time, and Wikipedia says he vows revenge despite Peter's heroics, so they end as enemies.
Jeanne appears as an intern from #2, but she is only revealed as Finesse, Daredevil's partner spying on Oscorp, in the finale (#10).
Richard Parker is first seen when May visits him in prison at the end of If This Be My Destiny... (#10).

value.title: Spider-Noir#5
value.text: Freed by Marko, Dirk Leyden joins Silvermane's crew.

split.title: Spider-Noir#8
split.text: Leyden attacks Silvermane's enemies for him, then tries to get Marko to help him overthrow Silvermane.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The mob boss Leyden plots to overthrow.
split.on_b_card_about_a: His electric enforcer, who turns on him.

verdicts.why: Marko frees Leyden to join Silvermane in Betrayal (#5). His attacks for Silvermane are in #6 and #7 and his plot to overthrow him is in #8, so those go to a split stage at #8.
In Worlds Apart Part Two (#2) Spider-Man learns John survived the crash and is fighting the High Evolutionary with the rebellion.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#61
value.text: The Thing is Mister Fantastic's teammate in the Fantastic Four, and Spider-Man brings the whole team to the Beyonder's world.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Reed's teammate in the Fantastic Four.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's team leader in the Fantastic Four.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#63
split.text: On the Beyonder's world, Doctor Doom kidnaps the Thing and gives him a watch that turns him human, something Reed has never been able to do.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Reed's teammate. Reed has never been able to cure him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's team leader, who has never cured him.

verdicts.why: The Fantastic Four are summoned in Arrival (#61). That Reed has never cured the Thing is only brought up by Doom's watch in #63, so it goes with the Doom facts into a split stage at #63.
Spider-Man summons the Fantastic Four, the Human Torch included, in Arrival (#61).
Miriam appears only in The Vampire Queen (#48) and #62. In #48 Spider-Man, Morbius, Blade and Black Cat stop her in New York and the others follow her across Europe.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#3
value.text: Alistair Smythe blames Spider-Man for his father's death and builds Spider-Slayers to kill him, until the Kingpin makes him work off his failure.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#63
split.text: The Kingpin has Alistair turned into a cyborg Spider-Slayer. Spider-Man helps him take back his frozen father, but Alistair goes on working for villains like Silvermane, and on the Beyonder's world he ends up aiding the heroes.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Builds Spider-Slayers to kill Peter.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The hero Alistair blames for his father's loss.

verdicts.why: The #3 start is right, but the cyborg turn (#35), Silvermane (#46) and the Beyonder's world are kept as a split stage at #63 instead of being dropped.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#28
value.text: Baron Mordo draws Mary Jane into his cult to free Dormammu, and Spider-Man teams with Doctor Strange to stop him.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
split.text: Mordo brings back Venom's symbiote and helps turn Cletus Kasady into Carnage to free Dormammu.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A sorcerer serving Dormammu.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Stands in Mordo's way.

verdicts.why: Mordo's cult and the Strange team-up are in #28. The symbiote's return (#37) and Carnage (#38) are kept as a split stage at #38.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#28
value.text: Dormammu tries to reach Earth through Baron Mordo's cult, and Spider-Man helps Doctor Strange keep him in the Dark Dimension.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A demon lord Peter helps keep off Earth.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Helps keep Dormammu out of Earth.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
split.text: Dormammu tries again to reach Earth through Venom and Carnage, and Spider-Man reverses the portal and sends him back.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A demon lord Peter sends back.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Seals Dormammu away.

verdicts.why: In #28 Spider-Man helps Strange and Wong stop Mordo from freeing Dormammu. The Venom and Carnage attempt and the reversed portal (#37 to #38) go to a split at #38, and the #28 cards no longer say he sends him back.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
value.text: After Xavier turns Spider-Man away, Beast tells him about Herbert Landon's cure for mutation. Landon's men then capture Beast.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Goes to Landon on Beast's word.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#18
split.text: Spider-Man searches for the captured Beast with Wolverine and helps rescue him from Landon.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Rescued by Peter from Landon.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Rescues Beast from Landon.

verdicts.why: Xavier's refusal, Beast's tip and Beast's capture are all in The Mutant Agenda (#17). The rescue in Mutants' Revenge (#18) is kept as a split stage.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
value.text: Dr. Herbert Landon offers mutants a cure while secretly planning to destroy them, and his men capture Beast.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist with a false cure for mutants.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#44
split.text: Landon becomes the Kingpin's chief scientist. He turns Alistair into a cyborg and Felicia into the Black Cat.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Kingpin's mad scientist.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A hero who foils Landon's work.

verdicts.why: In #17 Landon's cure is shown to be meant to kill mutants and Beast is captured. His work for the Kingpin on Alistair (#35) and Felicia (#44) is kept as a split stage at #44.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#22
value.text: Blade comes to New York to destroy Morbius, while Spider-Man wants to cure him. They clash over it but team up to stop Morbius.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#48
split.text: Spider-Man and Blade fight the vampire queen Miriam together.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A vampire hunter Peter works with.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A hero who wants to save Morbius, not destroy him like Blade.

verdicts.why: In #22 Blade and Spider-Man fight over Morbius, and at the end of that episode they decide to fight Morbius together, so the stage starts at #22, not #23. The Miriam fight (#48) is kept as a split.
Blade the Vampire Hunter (#22) ends with Spider-Man and Blade agreeing to fight Morbius together, so #22 does not leave them as rivals. Their clash is covered by the ally stage, now at #22.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#22
value.text: Whistler, Blade's mentor, comes to New York with Blade to hunt Morbius, and tells Spider-Man how he found Blade.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#48
split.text: Whistler joins the hunt for the vampire queen Miriam that Spider-Man helps stop.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Blade's mentor and Peter's ally.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A hero working with Blade, whom Whistler joins.

verdicts.why: Spider-Man tracks Blade to his base in #22, where Whistler tells him who they are and Blade's origin, so the stage starts at #22. Whistler tells Terri Lee in #23. The Miriam hunt (#48) is kept as a split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#58
value.text: Freed from a vortex decades after World War II, Captain America fights the Red Skull beside Spider-Man, then is lost in the vortex again.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#61
split.text: Spider-Man brings Captain America to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A hero Peter fights beside.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A modern hero Captain America fights beside.

verdicts.why: Cap fights the Red Skull and Electro beside Spider-Man and goes back into the vortex in The Price of Heroism (#58). His recruitment to the Beyonder's world (#61) is kept as a split stage.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#13
value.text: The Chameleon, a master of disguise, tries to kill two diplomats until Spider-Man and S.H.I.E.L.D. catch him.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#57
split.text: The Chameleon returns with the Insidious Six, helps frame Peter, and finally betrays the Kingpin for his stepfather, the Red Skull.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A spy who can wear any face.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Keeps catching the Chameleon.

verdicts.why: He debuts in Day of the Chameleon (#13). The Insidious Six (#14), the frame-up (#33) and his betrayal (#57) are kept as a split at #57.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
value.text: Dr. Curt Connors is Peter's science teacher at ESU. An experiment turns him into the Lizard, and Spider-Man has to bring him back.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#51
split.text: Connors helps Spider-Man with the alien symbiote and his mutation, but stress and his own experiments keep turning him back into the Lizard.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's science teacher, who sometimes becomes the Lizard.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Connors's student. As Spider-Man, brings him back from the Lizard.

verdicts.why: Night of the Lizard (#1) has Peter's teacher Connors turned into the Lizard. His help with the symbiote (#9) and the mutation, and his later Lizard turns up to #51, are kept as a split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#33
value.text: When Peter is framed for selling government secrets, lawyer Matt Murdock defends him, and as Daredevil he rescues Peter from a fake Spider-Man.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#34
split.text: As Daredevil, Matt helps Spider-Man clear Peter's name and reveals that Wilson Fisk is the Kingpin.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's lawyer, secretly Daredevil.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's client, and as Spider-Man, his partner.

verdicts.why: Peter meets his lawyer Matt and Daredevil rescues him in Framed (#33). Clearing his name and naming Fisk as the Kingpin are #34, kept as a split, and the #33 card no longer calls them partners.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#4
value.text: Doctor Octopus kidnaps Felicia to make her mother pay him, and Peter recognizes him as Otto Octavius, his old science teacher.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#30
split.text: Doctor Octopus fights Spider-Man again and again, leading the Insidious Six and even wiping his memory to use him as a partner in crime.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's old teacher, now a villain.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The hero who keeps stopping Doctor Octopus.

verdicts.why: He debuts in #4, where Peter recognizes his old science teacher. The Insidious Six (#14) and the memory wipe (#30) are kept as a split at #30.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
value.text: Eddie Brock is a rival reporter who competes with Peter for a picture of the Lizard.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#10
split.text: Jameson fires Eddie twice over stories about Spider-Man, and Eddie blames the hero for ruining his life.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A rival reporter to Peter.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A rival photographer of Eddie's at the Bugle.

verdicts.why: Peter and Eddie compete for the Lizard picture in #1. The two firings (#2 and #9) and his grudge are kept as a split at #10.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#2
value.text: Felicia Hardy is Peter's well-off classmate at ESU, and he starts dating her.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#32
split.text: After Spider-Man saves her mother, Felicia falls for him without knowing he is Peter and kisses him, but he tells her he cannot have a girlfriend.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate Peter dates, who falls for Spider-Man.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Felicia's classmate. Secretly Spider-Man, the hero she falls for.

verdicts.why: Felicia appears in #2, where she dances and kisses Peter at her charity ball, and he has a date with her in #4. The kiss with Spider-Man (#31) and his refusal (#32) are kept as a split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#44
value.text: Once the Kingpin's serum makes her the Black Cat, Felicia turns on him, and Spider-Man helps her free her father. They become partners in the field.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#63
split.text: Felicia and Spider-Man fight vampires, Hydro-Man and the villains of the Beyonder's world side by side, and they share a kiss there.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's partner in the field, with feelings for him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Felicia's partner in the field, and the man she loves.

verdicts.why: She becomes the Black Cat and Spider-Man helps free her father in #43 to #44. The vampires, Hydro-Man and Battleworld (#48 to #63) are kept as a split.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#12
value.text: Harry Osborn, Norman's son, is Peter's friend. Spider-Man brings him home when the Hobgoblin kidnaps him.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#35
split.text: Harry is for a while Peter's roommate, and he dates and gets engaged to Mary Jane while she is apart from Peter.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's friend and roommate, Norman Osborn's son.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Harry's friend and roommate.

verdicts.why: Spider-Man rescues Harry from the Hobgoblin and returns him to Norman in #12. The roommate period and the engagement to Mary Jane are kept as a split at the old title.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#49
value.text: Driven by visions of his lost father, Harry becomes the new Green Goblin and fights Spider-Man, until he collapses and Spider-Man takes him to get help.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#53
split.text: Harry is sent to Ravencroft, then returns as the Goblin to attack Peter's wedding to Mary Jane, until Liz Allan talks him down.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's friend, now the Green Goblin, out to kill him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The hero Harry blames for his father's loss.

verdicts.why: Harry becomes the second Goblin in #49. Ravencroft and the wedding attack (#53) are kept as a split.
Harry is on screen as Norman's son when the Hobgoblin kidnaps him to strike at Norman in #12. The limbo facts move to the new #49 stage.
In #49 the trapped Green Goblin calls to Harry and promises he will see his father if he becomes the second Goblin, so this carries the facts cut from the #12 stage.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#11
value.text: The Hobgoblin is a mercenary on a glider who plays Norman Osborn and the Kingpin against each other.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#40
split.text: The Hobgoblin kidnaps Harry, and he is finally exposed as Jason Macendale, Felicia's fiance, and arrested.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A goblin for hire.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Keeps foiling the Hobgoblin.

verdicts.why: He debuts in #11 working for Norman, then the Kingpin. The kidnapping of Harry (#12) and his exposure as Jason Macendale (#40) are kept as a split.
Spider-Man finds this world's living Ben and brings him to Spider-Carnage in Farewell, Spider-Man (#65).
The high-tech Spider-Man's world and its living Ben are shown in Farewell, Spider-Man (#65).

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#10
value.text: Quentin Beck works on the Chameleon's scheme to frame Spider-Man.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#25
split.text: As Mysterio, Beck attacks Spider-Man and is unmasked. Later he strikes again, but each Mysterio Spider-Man catches turns out to be a robot decoy.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Mysterio haunts with tricks and decoys.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A master of illusions Peter never quite catches.

verdicts.why: Beck is one of the Chameleon's crew framing Spider-Man in Persona (#10) and becomes Mysterio in Blueprints (#14). The unmasking and the robot decoys are kept as a split at the old title.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
value.text: Otto Octavius is a timid Oscorp scientist who works for Norman.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#6
split.text: Norman bullies Otto, and on his orders Otto runs the experiments that create the Sandman and the Rhino.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Norman's timid scientist, whom he bullies.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Otto's abusive boss.

verdicts.why: Otto is at Oscorp under Norman in #1, but Norman's bullying is shown with the Sandman (#5) and Rhino (#6) experiments, so those go to a split at #6.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
value.text: Eddie and Peter grew up like brothers, and Eddie is now the lab assistant in Connors's lab.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
split.text: Eddie, whose parents died in the same plane crash as Peter's, starts to resent Peter for never being there.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A big brother to Peter since childhood.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The little brother Eddie grew up with.

verdicts.why: Peter meets his childhood friend Eddie at Connors's lab in Survival of the Fittest (#1), not #2. His resentment builds later, so it is kept as a split at the old title.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#12
value.text: When Peter casts off the symbiote, it bonds to the vengeful Eddie, who becomes Venom.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#20
split.text: Venom goes after everyone Peter loves until Spider-Man strips the symbiote away, and Eddie is sent to Ravencroft.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's old friend, turned enemy as Venom.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The brother Eddie wants to destroy.

verdicts.why: Eddie bonds with the symbiote and becomes Venom at the end of Intervention (#12). His attacks (#13, #19 to #20) and Ravencroft (#20) are kept as a split at #20.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
value.text: Gwen is Peter's best friend and fellow intern in Dr. Connors's lab, and she has quietly loved him for years.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#14
split.text: After Venom targets her, Gwen kisses Peter, and he realizes he feels the same.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's best friend, who quietly loves him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Gwen's best friend, whom she has loved for years.

verdicts.why: Gwen is Peter's best friend and they both get Connors internships in #1, so the intern fact stays. The kiss (#13) and his realization (#14) are kept as a split instead of being dropped.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
value.text: Harry is Peter's best friend, neglected by his father Norman.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#9
split.text: Harry secretly takes an Oscorp formula, and Spider-Man finds him taking off the Green Goblin's mask. Harry then leaves for Europe to recover.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's best friend, Norman Osborn's neglected son.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Harry's best friend.

verdicts.why: Harry is Peter's best friend in #1, where Norman silently chides him. The formula, the Goblin mask and Europe are kept as a split at the old title.
